title: Image document fields (fragment)
description: Solr fields describing an image content item and its placement in a newspaper issue. This fragment is composed with core, access-rights, and image semantic-enrichment fields in the complete image Solr document.

linked_ci_s.title: Linked Content Item ID
linked_ci_s.description: Identifier of the related content item (CI), as identified by the OLR process.

reading_order_i.title: Reading order
reading_order_i.description: Reading order position of the content item within the issue.

page_nb_is.title: Page numbers
page_nb_is.description: Page numbers on which the content item appears.

front_b.title: Appears on front page
front_b.description: Indicates whether the content item appears on the front page of the issue.

cc_b.title: Converted Coordinates (legacy)
cc_b.description: Whether the content item has reliable coordinate information

caption_txt.title: Image caption
caption_txt.description: Original caption associated with the image.

coords_is.title: Image coordinates
coords_is.description: Bounding box of the image on the page, expressed as [x, y, width, height] in pixel coordinates.

iiif_url_s.title: IIIF image URL
iiif_url_s.description: IIIF Image API URL for the image.
